narrative.overview: Light enterprise surfaces, slate-blue structure and restrained amber markers frame a directly manipulable concept aircraft. Real object shading and soft physical elevation make the aircraft and hardware tangible. This records the implemented system from code.
dos: Keep the visible concept disclaimer and accessible controls.
